description: Search the place for instances by name and/or class.

class_name.description: Class the instance must be, including subclasses, e.g. "BasePart", "Script", "RemoteEvent". Optional.

name.description: Text the name must contain (case-insensitive). Optional.

root.description: Where to search. Instance path such as "game.Workspace.Model.Part" or "game.ServerScriptService.Main". Services are found by name. Default: game.

name: studio_find_instances
